==Active Ability: Terror==
[[File:BloodcurdleIcon.png|thumb|left]]
*x3 Menace's current DMG to every BLEEDING enemy inside his range (including Air)
*Ability can crit for x4.5 Menace's current DMG
*Stuns Enemies for 2 seconds
*10 Seconds Stun Cooldown on enemies which have been affected by it.
*20 Seconds Ability Cooldown (No Global Cooldown)

==Selling==

==Trivia==

*Menace's bleed damage is 30% of his damage

*Menace has the ability to become a potential full AOE with his active ability if paired with a meta bleed unit, with [[Berserker (Rage)]] he can damage air enemies while having full aoe, but having [[Saka (Ribbon)|Saka]] and [[Eccentric Researcher (Captain)]] have similar effects,
